x: A twenty-two-year-old walker of very great promise, Geoff. Gregory, has recently joined us and it may confidently be said that he is destined to win championships and appear in future winning Belgrave teams.

Geoff Gregory, competing in his first club championship, soon showed that he meant business and, walking in very fine style, led throughout to win in the fast time of 56 mins. 5 secs., a new championship record.

We cannot really describe the race without praising every one of our men and as space is pressing we cannot do this. However, we do register our regret at Geoff. Gregory's misfortune in being disqualified about 500 yards from home when among the leaders.

At three miles Geoffrey Gregory was leading in 22.20 and walking in fine style. Ron Kemp was 19th, George Checkley 32nd and Gordon Waddingham 34th.

Geoff Gregory, who decided a short time ago to turn to running, has now given up the idea and is training hard for walking again. He made a good start by easily winning the Tobacco Trades 7 miles Championship in London in March and is looking forward to a successful season on the track.
